data.title: 梦梦 · 玻璃花房水池的盛夏午后
data.description: 透亮玻璃穹顶下的热带植物花房中央有一汪清浅水池，彩花与蕨叶倒映在水面。梦梦赤脚踏在温润白石池沿上，手里轻提着一壶花洒给池边异星兰花浇水，浅紫荷叶边比基尼与细金腰链在阳光下熠熠生辉，她回头邀你一起在花香里消暑。
data.location: 阳光洒满的热带玻璃花房中央水池边
data.action: 赤脚立于白石池沿手提花洒照料花草，回头优雅浅笑
data.lighting: 玻璃穹顶倾泻的明亮日光与花叶通透光斑
data.camera: 全身略侧，热带花草与碧水倒影环绕四周
data.mood: 明艳、优雅、带着王女独有的浪漫情调
data.promptProse: Standing barefoot beside the clear stone pool inside a sunlit glass conservatory, Momo tilts a small watering can toward blooming exotic orchids. Bright daylight filters through the glass dome onto her lilac ruffled bikini and slender gold waist chain as she glances back with a radiant smile.
data.animaCaption: Barefoot beside the sunlit greenhouse pool, she waters exotic orchids and glances back with a charming smile.
data.nsfwProse: A delicate gold waist chain gleams against her bare midriff beneath the sunlit lilac ruffled halter bikini.
